title: Heinrich Weber, Lehrbuch der Algebra I-III — German transcription and English translation (working edition)
version: 2026-08-14 German I-III + corrected German Band II + partial English Band II through idx521/printed500
description:
Band-II milestone. The German Band-II transcription has its 1,300-row source audit terminal and is published as a German historical witness. Genuine Weber errors are preserved and noted rather than silently modernized.

English status. English Band II is partial through source index 521 / printed page 500 and resumes at source index 522. It is a first pass, not a canonical translation, and no whole-Band-II English completion is claimed.

The combined German reader retains the corrected Band I and the current Band III while replacing Band II with this corrected milestone.
notes: German Bands I-III are historical-witness working transcriptions. English Band I is a corrected complete first pass. English Band II is partial through source index 521 / printed page 500, resumes at index 522, and is neither canonical nor whole-band complete.
